messages:
carmen li: hey all — i'm Carmen, just started on Platform today! excited to join. quick thing: my MDM invite didn't pop for some reason and laptop battery is low. who should I ping for device enrollment/charger? also i'm bringing my tiny fern and considering soup for lunch (miso vs tom yum?)
izzy (onboarding buddy): welcome Carmen!! i'll resend the MDM invite in a sec. chargers are on the ops shelf (label 'new-hires') — grab one. miso is my vote ✅
marcos v: hey Carmen, welcome 👋 note that VPN creds come after MDM enrollment. if you need temporary access to the docs before that, DM me and i'll open a short-lived rule.
jamie (people ops): welcome!! lunch small welcome at 12:30 in kitchen. please fill any outstanding HR forms in the onboarding portal (you should've gotten an email). if anything missing, ping me. also love the fern idea (no soil on the table please)
ops-bot: [automated] MDM invite resent to carmen.li@redwood.com at 2026-03-10 16:12:05 UTC.
izzy (onboarding buddy): quick enroll steps:
```
1) open MDM email -> click "Enroll device"
2) download + install agent
3) approve device in 1Password (Onboarding vault)
4) reboot -> connect to redwood-vpn (WireGuard)
```
izzy (onboarding buddy): if you hit an error, paste the message here. common fix: reinstall agent + reboot.
carmen li: found the invite in spam (classic). starting install now. also miso it is, i'll bring a thermos. :)
marcos v: once on VPN, run `ssh git@redwood-repo` to validate repo access. if you see a passphrase prompt that's normal.
jamie (people ops): pro tip: label your container if you bring soup. someone always volunteers to ladle. :ramen:
izzy (onboarding buddy): adding you to #platform and calendar invites for weekly sync. i'll follow up on any missing perms after lunch.
carmen li: enrollment finished, laptop rebooted and VPN connected. uploaded an unnecessarily tiny fern photo here: https://imgur.com/example-f3rn (pls be gentle).
marcos v: adorable. welcome aboard — ping me if git perms are weird.
izzy (onboarding buddy): today's micro-checklist: MDM ✅ VPN ✅ Slack channels ✅ welcome lunch 12:30 ✅ bring spoon ✅
carmen li: thanks y'all — see you at lunch!
